prompt:

Company information (as of 2026-03-19):
| Return 3m            | +0.5% |
| Return 1m            | -5.0% |
| Return 1w            | -2.5% |
| Range position (63d) | 31% |
| 21d realized vol     | 34% |
| Last close           | 178.56 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock has shown negative momentum in the near term (1m and 1w declines) with high realized volatility, suggesting risk of further downside over the next few weeks. The 3m return is only modestly positive, offering little counterbalance to the recent weakness. Given the combination of recent underperformance and elevated volatility, a cautious stance is warranted.

DECISION: SELL
